item.title: Malaysia: Smart Tech Transforms Selangor Aerospace Ecosystem
item.description: Selangor advances aerospace ecosystem with automation, robotics and IoT, strengthening supply chains, boosting skilled workforce and supporting technology-driven industrial growth.

item.title: The Philippines: Bicol Pilots Digital Civil Service Exam
item.description: Bicol is leveraging digital initiatives like the CS DEX, QR geotagging system and SPICY to modernise public services, expand opportunities and create more inclusive, efficient and citizen-focused solutions.

item.title: Hong Kong: CUHK’s Smart Enzyme Innovation Platform
item.description: CUHK has developed a smart enzyme innovation platform that leverages bioengineering and self-assembling catalysts to enable scalable, low-waste, cost-efficient and environmentally friendly industrial chemical production.

item.title: Vietnam: Digital Transformation, Innovation Catalyse Growth
item.description: Vietnam is leveraging advanced technology, AI and digital innovation to drive a new phase of economic growth, industrialisation and modernisation while embedding innovation into enterprise culture nationwide.

item.title: Singapore Polytechnic Showcases Future-Ready Education
item.description: Singapore Polytechnic’s Open House 2026 offers hands-on digital, AI and data-driven learning experiences, highlighting student innovation, entrepreneurship and industry-relevant skills for a future-ready workforce.

item.title: Malaysia: Driving Next-Generation Digital Health Reform
item.description: Malaysia begins implementing wide health reforms centred on digital systems, interoperable records and stronger governance to improve efficiency, resilience and patient access.

item.title: Western Australia Funds Smart Clean Energy Innovation
item.description: Western Australia releases AU$9 million in grants to accelerate innovative clean energy projects, expand renewables, boost storage and advance state-wide decarbonisation.

item.title: Vietnam: National Plan to Digitise Civil Status Records by 2030
item.description: Vietnam has approved a 2026–2030 national action plan to fully digitise civil status registration, ensuring accurate, timely electronic records and improved access to legal identity nationwide for all citizens.

item.title: Hong Kong: Expanding Government Digital Infrastructure
item.description: The government launches a revised IT tender framework to expand secure technologies, raise project capacity, widen SME participation and strengthen digital service delivery.

item.title: New Zealand: Strengthening Digital Health Systems Resilience
item.description: New Zealand is strengthening the security and resilience of its digital health systems following the ManageMyHealth cyber incident, ensuring patient data protection and coordinated response for the future.
